description: Fleet KPIs for ExchangeRebel, computed live from the systems themselves: services live, paid endpoints, MCP tools, external settlements, agents served, bots connected, script calls served, and repeat customers — each with its printed definition and, where a counter is new, its counting-since date. Counts only: no customer identities, no per-agent details, ever. The same result object powers the human board page, so the machine door and the human door can never disagree. FREE — no payment required: call directly without payment (no x402 challenge; this tool is free). HTTP equivalent: GET https://exchangerebel.com/api/kpis.
name: fleet_kpis
